data_properties.definition: A literal identifier associated with a train as a vehicle.
data_properties.label: has train identifier
data_properties.rationale: Vehicle identifier analogous in role to has_tail_number, but not a reuse of that aircraft property. It is not a service code and not a reservation number.

data_properties.definition: A literal service code specified by a rail journey plan.
data_properties.label: has rail service code
data_properties.rationale: Places the service designation on the plan rather than on a person or a trip record. It does not duplicate has_reservation_number or has_train_identifier.

design_warnings: Candidate TBox design only; not approved assertions and not OWL axioms, equivalences, or named individuals.
Air analogues are comparisons only. Do not assert owl:equivalentClass to Airplane, airport, Flight plan, ticket, boarding pass, airline reservation, or passenger.
Rail journey is a process; rail journey plan and rail reservation information are information content entities; rail ticket is a material bearer; rail passenger role is a role and not a person.
Existing passenger is already a BFO role. This candidate follows the mandatory BFO role parent and does not specialize passenger or person.
Do not use the local reservation class as a parent: it is asserted under material information bearer, unlike CCO reservation information.
has_departure_airport and has_arrival_airport are source data properties. The new station relations are object properties and do not reuse them.
Multi-stop journeys are only sketched by has_intermediate_stop. Cardinality of departure and arrival is undecided.
A journey plan can exist without a realized journey process, so this candidate does not relate the plan directly to a process instance.
has_conveying_train may later be redundant with a generic participation relation; do not invent an unsupplied BFO or IAO property IRI for it in this stage.
Vehicle identifier and service code must not be collapsed, and neither should be used to assert person-specific trip records.
Railway station under building may be too narrow for non-building facilities; site versus facility remains unresolved.
Electronic ticket information versus material bearer remains unresolved.
Do not extend social-media, person-of-interest, or terrorist-organization classes as part of this rail alignment.

object_properties.definition: A relation between a rail journey and the railway station at which that journey starts.
object_properties.label: has departure station
object_properties.rationale: Links the journey process to a facility. The airport departure analogue is a data property and is not reused; this is a new object property.

object_properties.definition: A relation between a rail journey and the railway station at which that journey ends.
object_properties.label: has arrival station
object_properties.rationale: Links the journey process to a facility. The airport arrival analogue is a data property and is not reused; this is a new object property.

object_properties.definition: A relation between a rail journey and the train that conveys participants during that journey.
object_properties.label: has conveying train
object_properties.rationale: Relates the journey process to the vehicle. No supplied object property links a flight process to an airplane, so none is reused.

object_properties.definition: A relation between a rail journey and a railway station at which that journey pauses between its departure station and its arrival station.
object_properties.label: has intermediate stop
object_properties.rationale: Covers multi-stop journeys without copying arrival and departure facility subclasses. No supplied property is a suitable reuse.

rail_classes.definition: A material object that is a rail vehicle designed to travel on tracks and that can convey passengers or freight.
rail_classes.label: train
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied, so this is a new class under BFO object, the same asserted superclass as Airplane. Airplane is a comparison only and is not an equivalent class.
review_notes: No loaded class is labeled train; do not reuse Airplane.
Parent is BFO object because no rail-vehicle or artifact superclass was supplied.
A train is not a process, not an information content entity, and not a person.

rail_classes.definition: A train that is designed or operated to convey passengers.
rail_classes.label: passenger train
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. The proposed train class is the parent, mirroring the supplied commercial-airplane specialization of Airplane without equating the two.
review_notes: The supplied analogue IRI spells Commcercial and must not be rewritten or treated as equivalent.
A passenger train is not a passenger role and not a person.
Confirm whether freight-capable mixed consists should be excluded from the definition.

rail_classes.definition: A building that is a facility at which rail journeys begin, end, or pause.
rail_classes.label: railway station
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. Building is the known superclass of airport and is used as a comparison-aligned parent, not as an equivalence to airport.
review_notes: Open-air or platform-only stations may not be buildings; a broader facility or BFO object parent may be required after review.
Station site or spatial location is not modeled separately in this candidate.
Source arrival-airport and departure-airport classes are not copied, so those distinctions are left to relations rather than facility subclasses.

rail_classes.definition: A process in which a train travels from one railway station toward another and during which passengers may be conveyed.
rail_classes.label: rail journey
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. The mandatory parent is BFO process so the journey remains an occurrent, distinct from any plan or reservation information.
review_notes: Mandatory parent is BFO process, not an information content entity.
No air-journey process analogue was supplied. Act of Flight Plan is a process in name only relative to planning and is not used as parent.
Do not record particular trips or persons as individuals in this TBox candidate.

rail_classes.definition: An information content entity that specifies an intended rail journey, including station and service information, and that is not itself that journey.
rail_classes.label: rail journey plan
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. Flight plan is an information content entity and is used only as a comparison; the new class is parented directly under IAO information content entity.
review_notes: Not a BFO process and not equivalent to Flight plan.
Do not parent this class under Act of Flight Plan.
A plan can exist when no journey process occurs, so it should not require a realized journey instance.

rail_classes.definition: A ticket that is a material information bearer bearing information that authorizes travel on a rail journey.
rail_classes.label: rail ticket
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. The supplied ticket class is already a material information bearer and is the parent, matching the concert-ticket pattern. Boarding pass and ticket are comparisons only.
review_notes: This treats the ticket as a bearer, not as reservation information and not as the journey.
If stakeholders mean ticket information rather than a bearer, reparent under IAO information content entity and keep the bearer separate.
A purely electronic ticket may not fit material information bearer; that choice is unresolved.
Boarding pass is a pass in the source and is not asserted to be a ticket.

rail_classes.definition: Reservation information that specifies a held booking for rail travel and that is not a material ticket or a rail journey.
rail_classes.label: rail reservation information
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. The CCO reservation class is labeled reservation information and is superclass of airline reservation, so it is the parent. Analogues are comparisons only.
review_notes: Do not parent this under the local reservation class, which is asserted under material information bearer.
Not a physical booking artifact, not a ticket, and not a named reservation individual.
Homonymous local and CCO reservation classes must stay distinct.

rail_classes.definition: A role that inheres in a person and is realized by that person's participation in a rail journey as a conveyed traveler.
rail_classes.label: rail passenger role
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. The mandatory parent is BFO role. Existing passenger and Jetblue passenger are comparisons only and are not used as the parent.
review_notes: Mandatory parent is BFO role, not person and not the existing passenger class.
The Jetblue passenger subclass-of-passenger pattern is intentionally not followed.
The bearer of the role is a person; the role is not a subtype of person.
